verdict.rationale: Decagon's own docs show several product surfaces driven by natural language: AOPs define agent behavior in natural language, Watchtower takes flagging criteria in natural language, and Ask AI answers open-ended conversational queries over conversations. There is no evidence that the product as a whole, such as integrations, experiments, deployment and versioning, can be operated through natural-language commands, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: natural-language control across all product operations (integrations, experiments setup, deployment/versioning), any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: you can define agent behavior in natural language, the same way you train human agents with SOPs
